description: Route project work to phase-specific character roles.

hooks.command: /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import pathlib,runpy; c=pathlib.Path.cwd(); p=next(d / ".codex/hooks/phase_persona.py" for d in (c, *c.parents) if (d / ".codex/hooks/phase_persona.py").is_file()); runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name="__main__")'
hooks.commandWindows: py -3 -c "import pathlib,runpy; c=pathlib.Path.cwd(); p=next(d / '.codex/hooks/phase_persona.py' for d in (c, *c.parents) if (d / '.codex/hooks/phase_persona.py').is_file()); runpy.run_path(str(p), run_name='__main__')"
